newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bond future at high, dlr off on data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bond future at high, dlr off on data.

text.p: SYDNEY, July 31 (Reuter) The Australian 10-year bond futures contract hit an all time high of 93.650 and then rallied further, while the Australian dollar eased after June and second quarter retail proved weaker than expected.
June retail trade fell 1.8 percent, compared with a forecast rise of 0.4 percent, while the second quarter trade dropped 0.5 percent against an expected 0.1 percent rise.
The rise on the September 10-year bond contract took out the previous peak of 93.640 set last Thursday and having stood at 93.600 before the data.
The dollar was quoted at US$0.7430/35 compared with US$0.7450/55 just before the data.
September bills also firmed, moving to 95.08 from 95.07.
